decisions.reason: A multi-model line on its own page signals high visible commitment and investment, so despite any disappointing results, escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely.
The chair family has its own page and is close to the established offer, indicating public commitment and sunk investments that favor persistence.
Floor cushions from carpets are a product line with its own page, representing visible commitment and investment, so escalation of commitment predicts keeping it.

The sofa is only mentioned rather than given a page, so visible commitment is lower; however, it is close to the established offer and early results can be attributed to temporary causes, making a drop less likely than not.
A high standing table on its own page shows public commitment, though less investment than multi-model lines, and escalation of commitment still favors keeping it.
As a distant flagship presented as the focus of the firm's direction, the rug collection has high visibility, centrality, and investment, so escalation of commitment strongly predicts persistence.
